newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE shares rise after H1 96/97 figures.
newsitem.headline: RWE shares rise after H1 96/97 figures.

text.p: Shares in German diversified utility RWE rose sharply in afternoon share trade on Wednesday after it announced higher-than-expected turnover figures for the first half of 1996/97.
RWE shares were up 1.90 marks, or 2.57 percent, at 75.95 marks in afternoon IBIS electronic trade, while the IBIS DAX index itself was up 14.23 points, or 0.44 percent, at 3,247.75 points.
Analysts at Independent Research said sales in the first half, to end December, at 36.09 billion marks, were somewhat above expectations.
At the same time, first-half group net profits at 573 million marks were slightly below expectations, but overall, analysts said they were happy with the results.
